interpretation: Completed analysis on file does not mean every engine passed. Unsupported types are not successful checks. Undetected is not proof of safety or a source-code security audit. Per-file dates identify cached observations.
metadata_integrity: Generated reports are hashed by SHA256SUMS; the registry excludes itself and requires maintainer authentication after changes. No recursive antivirus self-scan is asserted.
scope: Current repository files only. Every ordinary file has a matching report observation by SHA-256 and size. Per-file dates distinguish retained and newly collected observations; generated metadata has separate integrity references.
